root_causes.pattern: Six domestic jobs past commissioning with a notification, certificate, handover pack or warranty registration not done or not filed. Team B has both overdue MCS certificates (SJ-1007, SJ-1039); Team C has both jobs closed as complete with a document missing (SJ-1025, SJ-1036).
root_causes.upstream_fix: Create G98/G99 notification, MCS certificate, handover pack and warranty registration tasks automatically on the commissioning date, each with a due date, and block the complete status until the document set is filed.

root_causes.pattern: Four records where two explanations fit the evidence: a wrong date or a real connection before G99 approval (SJ-1027), a supplier typo or a missing job (SJ-1140), and panel quantities that differ between design, delivery and job sheet (SJ-1031, SJ-1003). £2,076.00 of invoices sit in this group.
root_causes.upstream_fix: Add a commissioning sign-off where Office checks the job sheet against the DNO approval letter, the design and the delivery notes before the job moves on, and reject supplier invoices that do not quote a valid job ID.

root_causes.pattern: Four records with a value typed wrongly or left blank: a missing job sheet (SJ-1016), a kWp figure that does not match the panels fitted (SJ-1030), an install date a week apart between systems (SJ-1033) and a blank survey date (SJ-1021).
root_causes.upstream_fix: Make stage dates and the job sheet mandatory before a job can move stage, completed on a phone before the team leaves site, and calculate kWp from panels x watts instead of typing it.

root_causes.pattern: Three invoice lines dated Jun to Sep 2026 that should not have been paid as billed: one Kestrel Scaffolding Ltd line billed twice and two Brightfield Wholesale Ltd lines above agreed price. £1,813.80 in total.
root_causes.upstream_fix: Match every invoice line against the agreed price list and earlier invoices for the same job before it is approved for payment, and send the agreed price list with each purchase order.

root_causes.pattern: Three completed G98 domestic jobs (Team A: SJ-1009, SJ-1023; Team C: SJ-1014) where the panel, inverter or battery recorded as fitted differs from the tracker, with no record of approval.
root_causes.upstream_fix: Require Design sign-off, recorded in the tracker with a DNO route check, before any substituted panel, inverter or battery is fitted.

root_causes.pattern: Two jobs waiting on our own planning: a G99 application not submitted 21 days after design (SJ-1005) and an install not done 36 days after the scaffold was booked (SJ-1018).
root_causes.upstream_fix: Run a weekly look-ahead of jobs approaching their stage limit, and book scaffold only once an install date is confirmed.

root_causes.pattern: One commercial G99 application (SJ-1012) waiting 71 days for DNO approval against an allowance of 45.
root_causes.upstream_fix: Record the DNO reference on every application, chase at a fixed interval and escalate to the DNO when the stage limit is reached.
